selection_rationale: Select c3d4f581 (NetOps Safety Testbed and Baseline Benchmark). Rationale: highest combined novelty, reproducibility, and venue relevance in the reviews; directly addresses identified gaps (G1/G2) by delivering an integrated, reproducible testbed and public dataset; feasible within available resources and conference scope. Key supporting records: https://openalex.org/W4399629579, https://openalex.org/W3094502228, https://openalex.org/W2479024932, https://openalex.org/W4389520385. Reviewer verdict: pass (with repairs listed below).
unresolved_uncertainties: Cross-vendor external validity and production heterogeneity (Q1) — whether the synthetic/testbed tasks sufficiently represent real vendor/device behaviors.
Sufficiency of integrated verification+emulation to capture all unsafe-change modes (Q2/G2) — potential verifier false negatives and emulation fidelity limits.
Dataset representativeness and risk of missing realistic failure modes (G3) — whether synthetic/sanitized data will expose the same failure patterns as production configs.
Benchmark scope question (Q4) — what metric definitions (e.g., rollback cost, operator-latency) best capture operational correctness and how transferable they are across orgs.
required_repairs_before_preregistration: Enforce strict sanitization and synthetic-data provenance; document redaction/sanitization steps and provenance for every released artifact.
Provide a containerized testbed (Docker) with exact dependency versions and reproducible scripts to maximize reproducibility.

Preregister dataset composition, inclusion/exclusion rules, evaluation scripts, and metric definitions; include explicit documentation of external-validity limitations and guidance for future extension.
